resources.name: identity.tunner_sessions
personal_identifiers: HMAC identifier partition; no raw email
resources.bearer_storage: SHA256 lookup-key index; purpose-protected retry key and ticket; raw key only in trusted in-memory grant and framework-protected HttpOnly cookie
resources.lifecycle: Absolute/idle expiry is checked on every retrieval; immediate idempotent revoke and owner-invoked bounded expiry maintenance clear protected bearer material. Metadata retention remains governed by persisted trusted retention/processing references; no retention duration is invented.
resources.mutable_identity: Database trigger rejects key/Account/browser/scheme/origin/authentication/assurance/lifetime replacement and resurrection of ended sessions.

resources.name: identity.authentication_abuse
resources.lifecycle: Versioned policy window expiry; trusted maintenance deletes expired counters, with no raw IP/email/password retained.

resources.name: User BFF browser context and session cookies
resources.transport: HTTPS; host-only; Secure; HttpOnly; purpose-protected bootstrap; Strict bootstrap/antiforgery and existing Lax User cookie.
resources.browser_js_boundary: Only anti-CSRF request tokens, safe form values and authenticated=true enter JS state. No session bearer/OAuth tokens, account identifier, email or password in URLs/history/storage.

resources.name: platform.outbox_messages
resources.payload: Opaque operation/session reference only; no credential, email, network address, DOB or raw session lookup key.

providers: Trusted effective policy, Account access, processing/retention and published presentation sources are explicit; isolated fixtures are not production authority.
